issue_context.title: StatisticsLevel.Verbose causes serialization exceptions
issue_context.body:
- Orleans 2.0

**config:**
``` csharp
client = new ClientBuilder()
    .Configure<ClusterOptions>(options =>
    {
        options.ClusterId = clusterId;
        options.ServiceId = ServiceId.ToString();
    })
    .Configure<ClientStatisticsOptions>(options =>
    {
        options.CollectionLevel = StatisticsLevel.Verbose;
    })
    .UseZooKeeperClustering((ZooKeeperGatewayListProviderOptions options) =>
    {
        options.ConnectionString = zookeeper;
    })
    .ConfigureApplicationParts(parts => parts.AddApplicationPart(typeof(ISampleGrain).Assembly))
    .ConfigureLogging(logging=>logging.AddConsole())
    .Build();
```

review_comments:
I was more on move CollectQueueStats() method to `QueueTrackingStatistic` itself, since you did that in other StatisticGroup classes. So to keep consistent, we should move `bool CollectXXXStats()` into the `XXXStatisticGroup` class.

But this is fine, it is more like how it was before, as in whether to collect a Stats is in the same place of `CollectionLevel` settings. Only problem is that the pattern is not consistent over all StatisticGroup.  For example, `ApplicationRequestsStatisticsGroup ` has the `CollectXXXStats` method within itself. 

I will leave it to you to decide do you want to keep it consistent or not.
My intention is to rely more on *StatisticsGroup instances rather than the StatisticsCollector class (which is misnamed)
I went ahead and removed StatisticsCollector

this change looks good to me. the only thing I would suggest is since we splitted `StatisticsCollector ` and now each StatisticGroupe handle the bool on should the system collect their metrics or not in their own logic. This is consistent with the direction we are going with. But we also lost this single place we can look up on what does `StatisticsLevel ` really mean. Set it to a specific level would enable which metrics.  So I suggest put this info in `statisticsOptions.CollectionLevel ` xml comment
Sounds good to me, I'll come up with a better solution to keep some of the semantics localized
